confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living estimates (Numbeo, CityCost, BeaSavings, Trek.zone) with mixed dates, so they are medium quality. Beer is medium. Cocktail and wine are low: cocktail rests on scattered Kandy and upscale-hotel data, and the wine glass rests on one bottle-level figure plus the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages or current listings were checked, and the hostel and guesthouse levels are the least certain. FX is the RBA exchange-rate summary for 16 Oct 2026 as surfaced in search; the F11 historical table was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Nuwara Eliya's own aggregated cost-of-living estimates, cross-checked against Sri Lanka-wide averages and the similar central-highlands tourist towns of Kandy and Ella. Drink anchors lean on the local draught-beer relationship where direct data was thin.
